outcome: Management of neonates born to mothers with COVID-19
cohort: 5 neonates born to mothers with confirmed COVID-19 prior to delivery
finding: The study found no evidence of vertical or perinatal transmission of SARS-CoV-2 in 5 neonates born to mothers with COVID-19.
mod_finding: All 5 neonates were born via Cesarean section and none of the mothers breastfed during the hospital stay.
